title: feat(platform-objects): working calendars in Setup — sys_work_calendar and sys_work_calendar_exception (ADR-0157, part 2 of 2)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca1jJvsA1dHsPwMiQb
Fixes #35355
Blocked-by: #35641
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — the two objects are administrator data kept in Setup; a metadata author reaches a calendar only through the working-day formula functions and the approval escalation, whose own pull requests (#35356, #35357) teach it

## 维护者速读

用户能看到什么变化：系统管理员在「设置」里多了「工作日历」和「日历例外」两页，可以录每周上班时段、节假日和调休上班日，还能从文件一次导入一整年；之前没有这两页。
为什么做：属于「工作日历」，让按工作日计算的期限认得公司真实的上班日，不再把节假日当成工作日。
出错会怎样：若出错，管理员可能存不进合法的时段，或日历维护到期后期限计算被拒绝、提示先补录节假日；只新增两页、不改旧数据，可以直接撤回。
要你做什么：两页的十种外语译文是机器翻译、未经母语者审阅，请决定是否安排母语者校对。

## 席位核对

### Pair and release (ADR-0157 D4)

This is the second of two pull requests for #35355, split by layer because the whole change measured 3647 changed lines. Its pair is #35641 (the calendar service, the arithmetic, the three ledger codes and the write door), which must land first: this branch is cut from #35641's head, and this pull request's base is #35641's branch, so its own diff is this half alone. After #35641 lands, retarget this pull request to `main` and merge `main` into it; the diff then stays this half.

**Not released alone.** This pull request ships in the same release as #35641 and as #35356 (the working-day formula functions) and #35357 (the approval escalation's working-time clock), per ADR-0157 D4 and the ADR-0144 D9 precedent. The design choices this card made (P2, the past-side bound `maintained_from`, P3, P4, the 60-day lead, the server-side time-zone prefill) are listed for the contract review in #35641's body.

### What changes

- **`sys_work_calendar`** — `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-work-calendar.object.ts` (new). `code` (unique per organization, snake_case by a format rule on the spec pattern), `name`, required `timezone` (`iana_time_zone` value domain; a create without it takes the org's Localization zone in #35641's write hook), `is_default` (one per organization, judged by the write hook), required `maintained_from` and `maintained_through`, seven `*_periods` text columns (Weekly Hours group). `managedBy: system-data`, audited, organization-owned, like `sys_exchange_rate` (ADR-0144). List views: All, and Needs Maintenance (`maintained_through` within 60 days, the shared constant).
- **`sys_work_calendar_exception`** — `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-work-calendar-exception.object.ts` (new). `calendar` (lookup, required, cascade), `date`, `kind` (`off` Day Off / `on` Working Day), `periods`, `note`; unique index on (`calendar`, `date`) per organization (D10: one row per calendar and date); `userActions: { import: true }` — the generic import door, whose lookup resolver names the calendar by id, code or name.
- **Setup** — `setup-nav.contributions.ts`: Working Calendars and Calendar Exceptions under Configuration, after Exchange Rates; nav labels in all eleven locales.
- **Translations** — the eleven `*.objects.generated.ts` bundles regenerated by `scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`; every new key in the ten non-English locales is hand-filled. ⚠️ **These ten translations are machine-made (written by the agent), not reviewed by native speakers.**
- **Baselines the two objects require** — `PLATFORM_OBJECT_NAMES` (spec) gains both names; the CLI organization-ownership inventory (an exception reaches its org through `calendar`); the tenancy census; the bundle-ownership list; the Setup-tree pin (31 to 33 entries).

### Tests

All at head `c3e3d1be1e` (this half on top of #35641), each under `os-verify-lock`, each VERDICT `command-exit 0`:

- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: Test Files 124 passed (124), Tests 2063 passed — the plugin's object list, the owned-nav classification and the bundle-ownership list name both objects.
- `@objectstack/cli --project unit`: Test Files 431 passed (431), Tests 6158 passed — the ownership inventory test and the Setup-tree pin (33 entries, both new ids named).
- `@objectstack/spec` 858 files, 27407 passed, 1 todo; `@objectstack/core` 153 files, 3655 passed (re-run after a lock queue-timeout on the first attempt, exit 99, never acquired); `@objectstack/objectql` 617 files, 13933 passed.
- Typecheck exit 0 for spec, core, platform-objects, objectql and cli.

The service, arithmetic and write-door pins and their ablations are #35641's; the write door judges these objects through the same hooks those tests drive on fixture objects.
